name: smart-productivity
description: SmartProductivity — plan better, focus deeper, achieve more.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --prefix backend && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/smartproductivity_test JWT_SECRET=smartproductivity-integration-test-secret-only npm run test --prefix backend
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build

author: Prakash
